description: Render a subject + markdown body exactly as a recipient will receive it (subject, HTML and plain-text parts). Server-side on purpose: it runs the SAME renderer as fan-out, so the preview cannot drift from what actually goes out. Pass a `sample` contact to see the {{first_name}}-style merge fields filled in.

sample.description: A sample recipient to render the merge fields against.

subject_template.description: Subject line, may contain merge fields e.g. {{first_name}}.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: send_preview_broadcast
